speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Down syndrome with associated congenital heart defect (Ventricular Septal Defect).

The physical findings of epicanthus, upward slanting eyelids, low-set ears, a single transverse palmar crease, and a holosystolic murmur at the left lower sternal border are classic for Down syndrome and VSD. While the initial presentation of feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting suggests malrotation with volvulus, the specific physical signs in your script point to this genetic diagnosis.
